The petition requests that the Canadian government declare Hoekstra “persona non grata” due to his “US” diplomatic interference in Canadian domestic affairs”. Continue reading...

events.title: As UN Secretary General's last day approaches, search for his replacement continues
events.description: The UN Secretary General's term ends this year, but the big powers at the UN have been unable to agree on a replacement. UN watchers worry that there will be little time to get up to speed.

events.title: How American Thanksgiving took root — and evolved — in Liberia

events.title: Canada: Supreme Court largely upholds Quebec secularism bill

events.title: France seeks German man in Channel migrant boat probe

events.title: Kanal-Centre Pompidou, Brussels' most anticipated new art museum, opens its doors
events.description: A major addition to Europe's cultural scene: Kanal-Centre Pompidou, the new contemporary art museum in a former Citroen factory complex, is celebrating its opening with a free, nonstop weekend program.

events.title: Dutch authorities seize 26 critically endangered turtles from luggage of passenger bound for Hong Kong
events.description: The tiny Vallarta mud turtle was only discovered in 2018. It's critically endangered with around 300 thought to live in the wild. Almost one tenth of that number were stashed in a traveler's luggage, bound in duct tape.

events.title: Georgia: Police clash with Besiktas fans at Israel club game

events.title: S&P revises France's outlook from 'stable' to 'negative'
events.description: Rating agency S&P revised France’s outlook to "negative" from "stable" on Friday, citing growing budget pressures as weak economic growth and higher interest costs make it harder to reduce the deficit.

events.title: Spanish elections: 'Right-wing voters extremely mobilised, left-wing voters not mobilised enough'
events.description: “His main political platform is to say, I am not Sánchez, I am the opposite of Sánchez.” As Spain heads to the polls, what do Alberto Núñez Feijóo's campaign and political career tell us about the kind of prime minister he might become? Javier Carbonell, Policy Analyst at the European Politics and Institutions Programme and lecturer at Sciences Po in Paris, joins Gavin Lee to break down the Popular Party leader's efforts to avoid the mistakes of 2023 and keep right-wing voters mobilised without galvanising the left.

events.title: Spain races to stop oil spill after ship capsizes off Ibiza

events.title: Asia and Europe stocks rally after volatile week
